statement: The survivor is Morgan Hale, a male Evacuee in the Brokaw world.
The survivor starts in evac shelter B-05, where the first Brokaw morning is Spring day 61 at 8:00 AM.
Odell Hampton, a Chemical Engineer NPC in the shelter, asked the survivor to find him a big American flag.
A cupboard in the shelter holds 23 small cardboard boxes of protein ration.
The survivor carries 2 small cardboard boxes of protein ration in the messenger bag.
The survivor carries a matchbook (20 matches) and a smartphone with a flashlight.
A long pointy stick (the first one) is wielded as the survivor's weapon.
Long pointy stick is craftable from memory by whittling a long stick with a cutting tool, and long sticks lie on the grass beside the road outside the shelter.
Smashing a locked door with a wielded stick damages and snaps the stick; shoulder-checking the door with bare fists works instead.
The roof of the shelter holds a standing water tank, with about 14 litres (56 units) of water.
A locked wooden door in the shelter's southeast corner blocks the way to the roof.
The survivor marked the refugee center and the road leading to it on the map after reading the shelter board.
A separate, accidentally started random character (Len Gary, evac shelter A-23) exists in the Jayuya world and is not Morgan.
The survivor re-crafted an intact long pointy stick and wields it outdoors on the road northwest of the shelter at 8:10:59 AM.

note: Picked 2 cardboard boxes of protein ration from the cupboard.
Walking over the cupboard again showed 20 boxes remain.
Odell Hampton seen again in the shelter, with the flag request still open.
Crafted a long pointy stick from memory.
Rechecked the recipe, with 4 long sticks in hand, to recraft.
Smashed the door with bare shoulder-checks after the stick snapped.
The first long pointy stick snapped while smashing the door.
The door was smashed open, so the way to the roof is no longer blocked.
Inspected the standing tank on the roof while planning water.
